faq1_title: How does voice cloning work in Totora?
faq1_answer: Totora uses advanced voice synthesis technology to create a digital replica of your voice. Simply record a short audio sample, and our AI will learn your unique vocal characteristics. The cloned voice can then be used to narrate stories, providing children with the comfort and familiarity of a parent's voice during bedtime storytelling.
faq2_title: Is my child's data safe and private?
faq2_answer: Absolutely. Totora is built with privacy as a top priority. All voice recordings and personal data are stored locally on your device using industry-standard encryption. We never collect, store, or share any personal information about children. Parents have complete control over data through the app settings, including the ability to delete any information at any time.
faq3_title: Can I use Totora without an internet connection?
faq3_answer: Yes! Once you've downloaded the necessary AI models, Totora can create stories offline. However, you'll need an internet connection for initial setup, model downloads, and accessing certain advanced features like voice recognition and software updates.
faq4_title: What devices are compatible with Totora?
faq4_answer: Totora is optimized for iOS devices with iOS 16.0 or later. While it works on iPhone 12 and newer models, we recommend iPhone 14 or newer for the best experience. iPad support is currently in development and will be available in future updates.
faq5_title: How does the "Magic Grass" system work?
faq5_answer: Magic Grass is Totora's in-app enhancement system that allows you to add personal touches to stories. You earn Magic Grass through regular app usage and achievements, then spend it to unlock advanced story features like longer narratives, custom elements, and enhanced storytelling capabilities.
faq6_title: Can I export or share stories I've created?
faq6_answer: Yes! Stories created in Totora are saved to your personal library and can be exported as text files or shared directly with family members. You can also bookmark favorite stories for quick access during bedtime routines.
privacy_commitment: At Totora, we take your child's privacy seriously. We are committed to protecting your family's data and providing a safe, secure environment for magical storytelling.
privacy_data1: Voice recordings for story narration (stored locally on your device)
privacy_data3: Usage analytics to improve the app experience
privacy_data4: No personal information about children is collected or shared
privacy_usage2: To improve app functionality and user experience
privacy_usage4: Never for advertising or third-party marketing
privacy_security: All voice recordings and story data are encrypted and stored securely on your device. We use industry-standard security measures to protect your information.
privacy_parental_controls: Parents have full control over what data is collected and can delete any information at any time through the app settings.
privacy_contact: If you have questions about our privacy practices or need to exercise your data rights, please contact us at privacy@totora.app
privacy_voice_data_desc: We collect voice samples when you choose to create personalized stories. Your voice is used solely to generate custom storytelling experiences and is not shared with any third parties.
privacy_stories_desc: Stories you create and save are stored locally on your device. We do not access or analyze your personal story content unless you explicitly choose to share it with our support team for troubleshooting purposes.
privacy_usage_desc: We collect anonymous usage data to improve our app, including which features are used most frequently and crash reports. No personally identifiable information is collected.
privacy_personalization_desc: Your voice data is used to create personalized storytelling experiences with custom voice cloning for your children's bedtime stories.
privacy_improvement_desc: Anonymous usage data helps us identify bugs, improve performance, and develop new features that families will love.
privacy_support_desc: If you contact support, we may use relevant data to diagnose and resolve technical issues, with your explicit consent.
privacy_local_storage_desc: All personal data including voice samples and stories are stored locally on your device using iOS secure storage mechanisms.
privacy_encryption_desc: Voice data is encrypted during transmission and storage using industry-standard encryption protocols.
privacy_no_third_party_desc: We never sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing or advertising purposes.
privacy_parental_gate_desc: All features that could lead to purchases or external links are protected by age-appropriate parental controls.
privacy_age_appropriate_desc: All story content is carefully curated to be age-appropriate and educational for children aged 3-12 years.
privacy_no_ads_desc: Totora contains no third-party advertising or behavioral tracking. Your family's privacy is our priority.
privacy_access_desc: You can access, modify, or delete your voice data and stories at any time through the app settings.
privacy_data_export_desc: You can export all your stories and data from the app settings at any time.
privacy_account_deletion_desc: You can delete all your data and voice models from the app settings. Deleted data cannot be recovered.
privacy_updates_desc: We will notify you of any significant changes to our privacy practices through the app or email if you've provided contact information.
privacy_contact_privacy_desc: For privacy-related questions or concerns, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@totora.app. We respond to privacy inquiries within 48 hours.
privacy_effective_date_desc: This privacy policy is effective from December 1, 2024, and was last updated on November 6, 2024.
